paragraphs.text: 两级事件分诊闸（Super-agent架构Fast/Slow Path工程化）：第一级确定性代码规则秒杀噪音（白名单/来源/关键词·零成本零延迟），第二级候选事件才交大模型语义判断；规则表可配置可热更
，未命中规则自动落语义层——事件驱动的智能体装上即得过滤标准姿势。

**Two-stage event triage gate** — the engineering contract for Fast Path /
Slow Path filtering in ev

1. **Fast Path (deterministic rules, free & instant)**: whitelist / source /
keyword rules kill most

noise before any model call.
2. **Slow Path (semantic layer)**: unmatched candidates go to the LLM

Verdict per event: `ignore` / `candidate` / `act`, with the stage and reason
attached — so your agen

t knows whether the decision was made by code or
needs a model pass.

Rules are configurable via plugin config (`rules` array, evaluated in order,
first match wins). Unma
